profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer | Robotics & Autonomous Systems | Cloud and Edge Architect

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Led and contributed to the development of advanced autonomous drone operations for industrial inspections, focusing on wind turbines. Designed and implemented high-fidelity simulation environments, robust edge computing systems on DJI platforms, and secure edge-cloud communication. Engineered real-time blade tracking, enhanced ROS integrations, and built custom drone payload systems, driving significant advancements in autonomous data capture and system testing.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Managed and improved core iOS applications for drone flight control and inspection workflows. Architected comprehensive integration plans for new C++ software stacks into existing iOS applications, supporting diverse drone hardware. Developed product requirements and wireframes for advanced 3D facade inspection workflows, including sophisticated 3D UI for mission planning and georeferenced maps.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Joined an early team building a drone platform, contributing across the full stack from infrastructure and platform services to iOS applications and flight system architecture. Automated Kubernetes cluster creation, implemented CI/CD, and developed microservice templates. Architected and built a Kubernetes job scheduling engine, designed fault-tolerant cloud storage transfer APIs, and enhanced iOS flight engines with dynamic path generation and technical debt reduction. Designed cross-platform flight systems with shared C/C++ foundations and maintained/extended QGroundControl, developing open-source C++ image stitching and optimizing computer vision workflows for orthophoto and 3D model generation.

positions.title: DevOps Engineer
positions.description: Designed, automated, and supported a highly dynamic AWS infrastructure for SaaS backup and recovery products, managing hundreds of AWS resources and petabytes of data. Maintained 24/7 on-call rotation as a sole expert for critical systems like Cassandra clusters. Supported and debugged complex application topographies and played a hands-on role in all aspects of infrastructure. Designed and tuned multiple Cassandra clusters and developed automation for highly available, fault-tolerant systems using Chef and Terraform.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Contributed full-stack development to an experimental product, including AWS infrastructure, MongoDB management, server-side software, and UI/UX. Designed and implemented a dynamic MongoDB scaling system utilizing AWS services. Developed a virtual machine development environment and collaborated on a private patent search product with a user-friendly, responsive layout. Provided full-stack support for an existing enterprise product, addressing issues and implementing new features from server infrastructure to UI/UX.

positions.title: Lead Developer
positions.description: Developed and maintained all aspects of a rapidly growing website, including a suite of tools for editors, reviewers, bloggers, and authors, and supporting cloud-based systems. Designed, built, and optimized features for content-heavy site with rapidly growing traffic, implementing optimizations at every level. Developed an online ordering and workflow system and designed a scalable system of AWS cloud services. Automated bi-weekly magazine publishing using Adobe InDesign.

positions.title: Programmer
positions.description: Worked on a small team supporting several hundred e-commerce sites and developing backend software for integration with national wholesalers. Contributed to the design and building of a custom WSGI-based Python framework and a widget rendering system. Developed a web UI for customers to edit page designs and layouts and integrated major wholesaler's SOAP services, optimizing MySQL and XML processes for large nightly data transfers.
